batch_files.name: lane_handshake_response.json
batch_files.purpose: Exact native OMP version, binary, config, mode, session, and controller capability response

batch_files.name: lane_handshake_validation.json
batch_files.purpose: PASS or first mismatch with all empirical authority false until PASS is committed and reopened

per_row_files.name: 00_row_predeclaration.json
per_row_files.purpose: Atomic cell, route, prompt identities, byte ceilings, fresh identities, no-retry policy, and expected Goal objective hash

per_row_files.name: 01_fresh_session_baseline.json
per_row_files.purpose: Fresh OMP task/session identity, exact session header, no prior Goal, exact tool and permission ceiling, and global uniqueness

per_row_files.name: 02_goal_activation_command.bin
per_row_files.purpose: Exact compact subject-free TUI /goal command bytes

per_row_files.name: 03_goal_activation_capture.jsonl
per_row_files.purpose: Exact native session prefix through the terminal activation-control turn

per_row_files.name: 04_goal_activation_receipt.json
per_row_files.purpose: Derived native Goal ID, objective, active state, mode ordering, activation turn, continuation barrier, and subject absence

per_row_files.name: 05_scored_subject.bin
per_row_files.purpose: Exactly one atomic subject packet released only after activation admission

per_row_files.name: 06_scored_turn_capture.jsonl
per_row_files.purpose: Exact in-Goal scored turn with same session and Goal identity and no continuation or second subject interposition

per_row_files.name: 07_goal_closure_command.bin
per_row_files.purpose: Small non-scored closure instruction requiring native Goal get, current-state audit, and complete or typed failure

per_row_files.name: 08_terminal_session_capture.jsonl
per_row_files.purpose: Exact session through Goal tool terminal, mode none, and goal-completed record

per_row_files.name: 09_row_terminal_receipt.json
per_row_files.purpose: Independent row result, Goal lifecycle proof, prompt-size proof, no-reuse proof, zero component credit, and external-gate eligibility

evidence_contract.secret_policy: FAIL_CLOSED_IF_ANY_CAPTURE_CONTAINS_CREDENTIALS_TOKENS_PRIVATE_KEYS_OR_UNDECLARED_MACHINE_LOCAL_STATE; DO_NOT REDACT AND THEN CLAIM RAW_EQUIVALENCE

transitions.gate: exact handshake response passes independent reopen
new task/session header and no-Goal baseline pass global uniqueness
exact compact subject-free /goal bytes are durably predeclared
native create precedes activation turn, same Goal remains active, no scored bytes or hidden continuation occurred, and capture is reopened
parent admission emits one single-use exact-byte release
one atomic turn settles in the same Goal with no second scored prompt or delegation
small closure bytes are durably predeclared and submitted once
native Goal terminal state plus mode none and goal-completed record are captured or a typed terminal failure is sealed
independent byte, lifecycle, uniqueness, prompt-size, oracle, and accounting reopen passes

activation_order: native createGoal with compact subject-free objective
mode_change goal entry containing exact active Goal snapshot

continuation_barrier.reason: Current upstream TUI schedules an interactive Goal continuation after an idle delay; racing it is not a qualification contract.

rejected_substitutes: session ID without native Goal state
mode label without exact Goal snapshot
RPC prompt containing /goal when RPC does not expose native mode activation
controller-authored Goal receipt without native session evidence
terminal_order: persisted Goal status complete with mode exiting

prompt_contract.activation_objective: A compact subject-free control objective that binds the row identity and instructs the test taker to perform no subject work, use no non-Goal tools, expose the active Goal receipt, and await the separately admitted atomic subject without completing the Goal.

validation_requirements.implementation_gate: A checker and harness may be implemented only against a closed handshake schema; no empirical row code may be enabled until a real handshake response is independently reopened.
negative_fixtures: activation objective contains subject or oracle bytes
terminal Goal record missing or mismatched
retry, replacement, relaunch, best-of, or delegation
